description: The current US hiring market for one healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal, marketing, sales, customer service, admin, operations and logistics, skilled trades, retail and food, or education occupation, nationally or in one state: live postings, employers hiring, the posted pay range and employment type. Read from employers' own careers sites and rebuilt daily. Occupation in plain words (e.g. "registered nurse", "accountant", "software engineer", "truck driver", "warehouse", "cashier", "electrician", "teacher", "customer service"); state as a code or name, or US. Free; no employer is named. How fast employers close the role, what each requires, and one posting against every employer hiring it by name are in the Competitive Hiring Report (request_competitive_hiring_report; first report free).
